an7.96-614:12.13: āhuneyyavaggo → yathā ‘cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati’ iccādivasena ‘cakkhuṃ’ nissāya aṭṭhasuttāni honti. tatheva sotādi catusaṭṭhipadesu ekekaṃ nissāyapi anicca (dukkha anatta - khaya - vaya - virāga - nirodha - paṭinissagga anupassanā vasena aṭṭhaṭṭhasuttānilabbhanti tasmā imasmiṃ vagge vīsatyadhika pañcasuttāni honti.)
